description: This file defines the 'Compiler' class within the Twig templating engine, responsible for compiling Node objects into executable PHP code, managing source code generation, indentation, and debug info.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: A class that compiles Twig nodes into PHP source code, providing methods for raw code addition, code generation, string representation, and debug info management.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the associated Environment object for this compiler.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the generated PHP source code string.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the compiler, optionally setting indentation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a given Node object into source code, managing indentation and deprecation checks.

methods.name: subcompile
methods.description: Subcompiles a Node object, optionally adding indentation.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Adds raw PHP code directly to the source.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes strings to the source with indentation.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Adds a PHP quoted string to the source.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Converts PHP values into proper PHP source code representation.

methods.name: addDebugInfo
methods.description: Adds debugging information related to a Node.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of debug information.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level with safety check.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique variable name for use in the generated code.

methods.name: checkForEcho
methods.description: Checks if a string contains echo or print statements and sets a flag accordingly.
